content.text:
I fixed all three problems in `src/queue.js` and added 8 regression tests. `npm test` passes: 10/10. Against the old queue, 5 of the new tests fail, so they do catch the reported bugs.

| Problem | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Hangs forever after a job fails | When a job failed, the running count never went down and the next job never started. A job that threw immediately or returned a plain value made `fn().then` itself throw. | Each job now runs through `Promise.resolve().then(fn)`, so promises, plain values and immediate throws are handled the same way. Cleanup (decrement, start the next job, check for idle) runs whether the job succeeds or fails. |
| `onIdle()` resolves while jobs are still running | It only checked that the waiting list was empty. | It now also requires that no jobs are running. |
| Only one job at a time after `pause()`/`resume()` | `next()` started at most one job per call. | `next()` now keeps starting jobs until all free slots are full or nothing is waiting. |

The new tests in `test/queue.test.js` cover:
- a failing job not stopping the queue
- jobs that throw immediately or return plain values
- `onIdle()` waiting for running jobs
- `onIdle()` resolving immediately when already idle
- `onIdle()` resolving after the last job fails
- the concurrency limit being respected
- `resume()` filling all 4 slots
- `pause()` letting running jobs finish without starting new ones

I haven't committed anything.
